author: Puysegur
body:
download: https://www.dropbox.com/sh/oar6tzhhpflegvo/AACMevR5W8KoZvd1R84pxOa3a?dl=0
(that should work, never done this before)
images: http://imgur.com/a/UgMY3
ver 1.8

I've noticed there are some maps that are incredibly large. I personally love small maps with close encounters and no time to just chill. So I made this specifically to my tastes, and hopefully it will appeal to others too. 

Two teams, orange and pink. 1000+ iron blocks for each team. hidden items stashed away around the map. interactive robots. 3 obsidian monuments overlooked by a porch at the back of spawn. Other things I can't remember because I made it ages ago and was waiting for 1.8 so I could use the ocean light things.
Give any feedback, feel free to download the map and play around with it. And if the download doesn't work... idk. Tell me how to set it up correctly I guess

I also realize there is no .yml file. This is because I don't know what that is, let alone how to do it. If this map has enough positive feedback, I'll look into trying to do it (or maybe a really nice person could help me)

Ok thanks, have a good day

replies.author: itaity
replies.body:
Sorry, but as for now, the map has been denied, for the following reasons:
  • The planets in this map are just big spheres from a uniform material, the towers are just big cylinders with spheres on top. this makes the map very unaesthetic.
  •  Generally it has a lack of details.
  • There arent any platforms between the spawns, which may make the gameplay of this map to be a pure archers vs rushers gameplay.
Of course you can improve the map and update it, and it will be reconsidered.

replies.author: Puysegur
replies.body:
Aaaaaw making me blush guys <3

Nah okay, taking it all onboard. I'm just happy people somewhat like it :)

Sorry, but as for now, the map has been denied, for the following reasons:
  • The planets in this map are just big spheres from a uniform material, the towers are just big cylinders with spheres on top. this makes the map very unaesthetic.
  •  Generally it has a lack of details.
  • There arent any platforms between the spawns, which may make the gameplay of this map to be a pure archers vs rushers gameplay.
Of course you can improve the map and update it, and it will be reconsidered.

I'm not sure what you want me to do about the big spheres and towers, I made them like that for a reason ;s
Any details you would like to see?
I don't want it getting too cluttered, I personally feel the beauty of it comes from the simplicity. Many others have also said there needs to be more pvp space, and someone else suggested, I'll make some flat asteroid type things :)

Don't forget though that I actually made this map with horizontal AND vertical gameplay in mind. There is no stopping someone from digging to the bottom and attacking from there.

Any other suggestions from anyone?
